plain: The ACP request header that names the dated protocol version a client speaks, such as 2026-04-17.
ste: The header that gives the version date of ACP that the client uses.

plain: ACP endpoints, added in 2026-04-17, that run 3-D Secure 2 fingerprinting, challenges and results on behalf of an agent.
ste: ACP endpoints that do 3-D Secure checks for the agent.

plain: An optional object on an ACP cancel request with a reason code, such as shipping_cost, that says why the buyer did not finish.
ste: Data that tells the merchant why the buyer stopped the purchase.

plain: An ACP payment handler for value the merchant holds, such as a saved card, gift card, points or store credit, so no card moves to the agent.
ste: A payment method that the merchant keeps, for example a gift card or points.

plain: The unauthenticated JSON file at /.well-known/acp.json that lists a seller's ACP versions, transports and services.
ste: A public file on the server of the seller. It gives the ACP versions and services.

plain: The ACP 2026-04-17 API, hosted by the agent, that merchants call to push product and variant data.
ste: An API on the agent side. The merchant uses it to send product data.

plain: The header on ACP order webhooks that carries a Unix timestamp and an HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw body.
ste: The header that has the time and the HMAC signature of an order message.

plain: A signed message from the merchant to the agent about an ACP order, with event type order_create or order_update.
ste: A message from the merchant to the agent about the status of an order.

plain: ChatGPT's 2025 in-chat purchase feature that launched ACP; OpenAI scaled it back in March 2026 in favor of merchant checkout.
ste: The 2025 ChatGPT function that let a buyer pay in the chat. OpenAI made it smaller in 2026.

plain: The ACP change process for major changes: a TSC sponsor, a 7-business-day public review and a simple majority vote.
ste: A formal request to change the ACP specification.

plain: An Apps SDK checkout surface in ChatGPT, in private beta for select marketplace partners, that sends a payment token to the merchant's MCP server.
ste: A payment window in ChatGPT apps. Only some partners can use it.

plain: An ACP order entry for a change after purchase, such as a refund, return, exchange or dispute, with status pending, completed or failed.
ste: A change to an order after the purchase, for example a refund.

plain: The required limits on an ACP delegated token: one-time use, a maximum amount and currency, one merchant, one checkout session and an expiry.
ste: The limits of a token: one use, a maximum amount, one merchant, one session and an end time.
